___note: Dedicated fixture for tests/harness/askcard.spec.ts. It must NOT live in the shared tests/harness/fixtures/llm dir: createMockLlm (packages/agent-harness-core/src/mock-llm.ts) tries every SEQUENCE fixture in a directory before any responses fixture, so council.json's positional sequence would win and this wildcard would never be reached.
___why_two_blocks: The TUI has two independent mock hooks. `model` feeds globalThis.__muonroiMockModel (src/providers/runtime.ts) — the AI-SDK path used by the agent turn and by PIL's model-first classifier. `responses` feeds globalThis.__muonroiMockLlm (src/council/llm.ts getMockLlm) — the path EVERY council generate/debate/research call short-circuits through. The council askcard this spec drives comes from the second hook; without the first, the classify call would reach a real provider.
___how_the_card_appears: /ideal --force-council → loop-driver gather → runClarification (src/council/clarifier.ts:490-540) asks the leader for clarification questions and parses the reply with /\[[\s\S]*\]/ + JSON.parse. Returning this array gives it one real question, so it yields a `council_question` chunk; use-app-logic.tsx:4162-4198 renders CouncilQuestionCard (<Semantic id="askcard" role="dialog">) and emits the askcard-open LiveEvent, then the run BLOCKS on respondToQuestion. That block is what keeps the card on screen for the navigation test.
